name: Stage 36: Nävsjön to Nävekvarn
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 36, Nävsjön to Nävekvarn.
utilities: Nävsjön has parking before the fishing association area, about 200 m from the trail, plus pump/fishery access. Nävekvarn has Gula Kvarn parking, bus 561 toward Nyköping, camping/guesthouse, summer tap, toilets, Parkbadet, harbor food/service, grocery/deli, and lodging options.

Public transport is practical at the Nävekvarn end via bus 561. Nävsjön is weak by transit; Nävsjövägen bus access is several km from the lake, and Nyköping C is the practical rail anchor for the Nävekvarn side.
waterSources: Official water: Nävsjön pump at the start and the spring south of Nävsjön after about 2.5 km. Sörmlandsleden explicitly says trail water is not routinely checked, so verify/treat/filter.
In summer, water can be fetched from a tap at Nävekvarn camping; mapped drinking water near the camping/harbor should still be treated as seasonal/service-dependent.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km. Secondary sources such as AllTrails and Äventyrligare are around 10 km, and OSM relation 3821815 measures about 10.2 km. Keep 11 km as the planning distance but describe the drawn geometry as about 10-11 km rather than exact.

The older local/Naturkartan-derived geometry exposed a stale 7767 m line and missed the Bråviken/Vibberholmen/Nävekvarns klint arc. Stage 36 should be drawn from OSM relation 3821815, with the official Gula Kvarn endpoint used for stage chaining.

Official fault status showed no reported faults as of 2026-04-27. Nearby warnings on Stage 36:1, including the Bötesberget powerline passage and 2026 Stora Bötet conservation burn notices, should not be applied to Stage 36 unless the user selects that branch.

The stage is relatively easy overall but varied: lake/forest by Nävsjön, sparse conifer forest, hällmark/rocky knolls, mining/cultural-history points, ravine descent, Bråviken coast, and the steep Nävekvarns klint climb/descent before Nävekvarn. Hiker reports caution that the repeated small rocky ups/downs can feel more tiring than the official wording suggests, especially in heat or late in a long day.

Wet weather makes the Bråviken/Nävekvarns klint side more demanding, with slippery rocks, polished roots, boardwalks, mud and coastal rock reported by hikers. Older reports also describe forestry/logging damage on parts north of the gravel-road middle section, so current trail condition can matter.
Camping/tenting may be possible around Nävsjön only outside the nature-reserve parts; do not present Nävsjön reserve itself as a tenting or fire area.

Nävsjön reserve: no tenting, no fires, dogs leashed, no damaging living/dead wood, and no plant picking except berries/mushrooms. Nävsjömossen allows fires only at arranged grill places and no new fire rings; Nävekvarns klint requires bringing your own firewood and forbids taking live or dead reserve wood.

Do not present the early shelters as guaranteed comfortable overnight infrastructure: the west Nävsjön shelter is primarily for fishers, the Nävsjön Öst shelter is small, and recent OSM/community notes flag Kolarkojan as fire-damaged/charred.

Stage 36 has several overlapping local route options near Nävekvarn. Keep Skäret and Nävekvarnsslingan/Nävekvarns klint as optional loops or side variants; do not merge them into the linear Stage 36 unless the itinerary explicitly asks for a scenic loop.

facilities.name: Nävsjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage 36 start and junction with stage 35 and 36:1. Parking is before the fishing association area, about 200 m from the trail; distinguish legal hiker parking from fishery/fee parking.

facilities.name: Nävsjön pump
facilities.description: Official pump at the start. Sörmlandsleden says water along the trail is not routinely checked; verify/treat/filter.

facilities.name: Nävsjön parking/fishery access
facilities.description: Parking before/near the fishery area and fishing-card machine. Some parking inside the fishing association area requires a valid fishing permit; non-fishing visitors should use signed free hiker/reserve parking and not block fishery access.

facilities.name: Nävsjön fishing permit machine
facilities.description: Fishing permits are sold at Nävsjön. Permit required for stocked fish; local rules restrict tackle, catch limits, bait fish and electronic aids. Prices and boat/cabin availability can change, so check Nävsjön Sportfiske.

facilities.name: Nävsjön fishing shelter
facilities.description: Shelter a few hundred metres from the start, primarily for fishers; hikers may use it if space is available. Treat capacity and condition as field-check items.

facilities.name: Nävsjön Öst shelter
facilities.description: Small shelter context near the eastern lake side; recent map notes describe limited capacity and wind gaps, so do not rely on it as a comfortable overnight stop.

facilities.name: Nävsjön kolarkoja
facilities.description: Overnight hut less than 1 km into the stage. OSM/community notes report fire damage/charred interior and very limited capacity; verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near the Kolarkoja/Nävsjömossen rest area; verify on site.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja arranged fireplace
facilities.description: Nävsjömossen context: use only arranged fireplaces, do not build new fire rings, and use brought/supplied wood only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Spring south of Nävsjön
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 2.5 km; untreated/unchecked, so treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: Damkärrsgruvorna
facilities.description: Fenced old mine-remain area before Kvarsebovägen. Pin uses nearby OSM Dammkärr/locality context because an exact official mine object coordinate was not verified.

facilities.name: Old tar valley after Kvarsebovägen
facilities.description: Cultural-history point just after/near Kvarsebovägen; no reliable exact coordinate found, so treat this as approximate route-context rather than a precise ruin marker.

facilities.name: Vibberholmen grill/rest
facilities.description: Official fine rest/grill place by Bråviken on the corrected Stage 36 route. Exact grill coordinate is not independently verified; use only when current fire-ban status and local signs allow.

facilities.name: Vibberholmen cholera cemetery
facilities.description: Signed cholera cemetery/cultural-history point near Bråviken.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns klint viewpoint
facilities.description: Major Bråviken viewpoint and natural fika point; steep climb/descent and slippery in wet weather.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns klint parking
facilities.description: Reserve/loop access parking about 2 km west-southwest of Nävekvarn, useful for partial hikes and Nävekvarnsslingan.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns klint fireplace/rest
facilities.description: Bring your own firewood; Länsstyrelsen says no wood is supplied and dead/living wood must not be taken from the reserve.

facilities.name: Skäret grill/rest areas
facilities.description: Optional Skäret detour/rest context from the harbor, not core Stage 36. Sörmlandsleden mentions grill places and firewood here, but reserve/site rules and fire bans still override use.

facilities.name: Skäret weather shelter
facilities.description: Weather shelter/rest context on optional Skäret detour; not an official stage-36 overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Skäret bathing cliffs
facilities.description: Optional Skäret side-loop bathing/picnic cliff context near Nävekvarn. Not part of the linear Stage 36 unless the user selects the Skäret detour.

facilities.name: Parkbadet / Nävekvarn swim
facilities.description: Bathing by Nävekvarn camping/Folkets park area.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns Skärgårdscamping
facilities.description: Camping/guesthouse/cabins and seasonal services near Parkbadet and the harbor; booking and opening periods should be checked before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn camping water tap
facilities.description: Official stage page says summer water can be fetched from a tap at Nävekvarn camping; verify season/access.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn camping / Parkbadet toilet
facilities.description: Toilet near bathing/camping area; seasonal/service access should be verified.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns guest harbor services
facilities.description: Harbor service cluster with toilets, showers, fresh water, restaurant/kiosk/tourist-info context, parking and nearby grocery. Many services are seasonal; verify opening/access.

facilities.name: Systrarna Brådhes cafe/harbor food
facilities.description: Harbor cafe/restaurant/service context; seasonal hours vary and should be checked before depending on it.

facilities.name: Matöppet Nävekvarn / Brådhes Livs & Deli
facilities.description: Central Nävekvarn grocery/deli/service point with Postnord/DHL, Systembolag and pharmacy-agent context; verify current hours.

facilities.name: Marinans Guesthouse
facilities.description: Guesthouse near Nävekvarn harbor, listed as local lodging context.

facilities.name: Gula Kvarn / Nävekvarn stage end
facilities.description: Official end area at Nyköpingsvägen-Utterviksvägen and start of stage 37. Easy parking nearby.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn bus stop
facilities.description: Bus 561 toward Nyköping; nearest practical public-transport endpoint. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken times instead of relying on static schedules.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Practical rail anchor for the Nävekvarn side via bus 561, but about 18 km from the trail; mark as off-route access.

facilities.name: Nävsjövägen bus access
facilities.description: Nearest researched bus access to Nävsjön side, several km from the lake by road; verify service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävsjön reserve rules
facilities.description: Nävsjön reserve: no tenting, no fires, dogs leashed, no damaging living/dead wood, and no plant picking except berries/mushrooms.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns klint reserve rules
facilities.description: Do not damage living/dead trees or collect protected plants/fungi/lichens; bring your own firewood for fire places and do not take reserve wood.

facilities.name: Stage 36 corrected route source
facilities.description: Drawn line uses OSM relation 3821815 because the older local/Naturkartan-derived line was about 7.6 km and missed the coastal Klint arc. Keep official 11 km as the planning distance; keep Skäret and Nävekvarnsslingan as optional loops.
